data.one_liner: DTLS library for Dart implemented via FFI bindings to OpenSSL.
data.what_it_does: Provides datagram socket encryption through a client and server implementation supporting DTLS in PKI and PSK mode via OpenSSL FFI bindings.
use_when: You need encrypted datagram socket communication (DTLS) in a Dart or Flutter app.
You are targeting native platforms (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux) and can bundle or preinstall OpenSSL.
avoid_when: You are building for the Web, as datagram sockets and this package are not supported on web platforms.
You want to avoid external native dependencies like OpenSSL.
strengths: Offers both client and server implementations with PKI and PSK mode support.
Familiar Stream-based and connection-oriented API wrapping RawDatagramSocket.
weaknesses: Requires OpenSSL dynamic libraries (libssl and libcrypto) to be available or bundled on the target platform.
Connecting to a server currently does not work on macOS.
Handshake message corruption can occur when too many cipher suites are offered.
data.setup_notes: Requires libssl and libcrypto from OpenSSL to be available. On Android, iOS, Windows, and macOS they often need to be bundled or installed via package managers like Homebrew or Chocolatey.
